## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for users?

Related issue, if any. Use `Closes #123` only when this PR resolves it.

Mention effects on routing, permissions, saved data, or existing sessions when relevant. For a larger change, explain why the parts belong together and where to start reviewing.

## Verification

List commands and actual results. Include failures, skipped checks, and anything not run. For app changes, name the OS tested; for UI changes, attach screenshots. Draft PRs can arrive before checks finish.

## Contribution details

- AI tools used and what they did, or `none`. No particular tool is required; add `ai-made` when applicable.
- Confirm the diff contains no secrets, credentials, private content, or unredacted logs.
- Note license changes for new dependencies.

- [ ] I have read and agree to the Contributor License Agreement (docs/CLA.md).
